elaine_sec: Planning a constrained RBAC canary for keystore next Wed 02:00 UTC. Goal: grant decrypt to canary pods only. Need preflight checklist for mTLS impact + audit requirements.

vik_kms: Suggest create a canary key (arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/ks-canary) and tag principals. Use explicit Deny for prod-key unless principal tag == keystore-canary.

mike_ops: We'll do traffic slicing (10% -> 30%) and include a manual hold. Preflight items: cert path validation, ALPN check, cipher compatibility, and session ticket issuance test.

tara_prodsec: Audit: capture kms:Decrypt attempts with principal_arn, principal_tags, request_id, peer_cert_sha256. For the first 48h, sample 100% for canary, 5% for baseline. Push to secure-audit sink with 7d retention.

elaine_sec: Fallback plan if decrypt denies spike: proxy attempts fallback-keystore in ap-south. Verify fallback cert chain and cipher set before enabling. If handshake_failure_rate > 1% over 5m we abort.

mike_ops: Preflight command for validation:
```
./cert-validate --keystores ks-canary,ks-secondary --regions eu-west-1,ap-south-1 --min-tls 1.3 --alpn h2 --out /tmp/preflight.json
```
Will post results.

vik_kms: Note: KMS metrics have ~60s lag. Use proxy-side logs for quick detection and KMS CloudAudit for forensic. We'll create a narrow policy and an audit sink.

tara_prodsec: Also ensure we do NOT change cipher suites during this RBAC rollout. Any TLS hardening must be a separate change.

alert-bot: alert-configured: metric=keystore.handshake_failure_rate; threshold=0.01; window=5m; notify=@eng-oncall,@eng-security; runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-canary

elaine_sec: Action items:
- vik_kms: prepare canary key policy + audit sink (due EOD)
- mike_ops: preflight job + smoke tests (due EOD)
- tara_prodsec: sampling & ELK queries (due EOD)
- elaine_sec: schedule rollout + update runbook

mike_ops: I'll run small smoke (512B/8KB) to exercise KV cache. Posting preflight artifact when done.

vik_kms: Will share policy snippet here and tag principals.

tara_prodsec: I'll add saved ELK query for request_id correlation and an emergency rollback notify template.

elaine_sec: Thanks. Quick sync in 15 to walk through the scripts. Meeting: https://meet.redwood.internal/keystore-canary-checks
